name: Necklace of Venom
upgradeable: Epic Crafting to Epic Necklace of Venom

effects.name: Vulkoor's Cunning
effects.tooltip: Vulkoor's Cunning : 2 Pieces Equipped: -20% Artifact bonus to Melee Threat Reduction +5 Artifact bonus to Melee and Ranged Power You gain On Vorpal: You apply a Vulkoorim Constitution Poison

effects.name: Proof Against Poison
effects.tooltip: Proof Against Poison +6 : This item grants its wearer immunity to natural poisons. This item also grants a +6 Enhancement bonus to saving throws against magical poisons, and the wearer does not fail saving throws against them on a roll of a natural 1 (this renders the wearer immune to magical poisons with a DC of less than 7 + their Fortitude save).

effects.name: False Life
effects.tooltip: False Life +17 : +17 Enhancement bonus to hit points.

flavor_text: Drow assassins say this necklace is infused with Vulkoor's subtle poisons. Wearing it will make one's attacks deft and lethal.
tips: Old versions had standard False Life . They don't retroactively change but have to be reacquired.

source.raw: The Claw of Vulkoor , End reward
